Title: Evening Reception
Blurb: Enjoy an opportunity to network with peers while strolling through the Jayhawk Welcome Center, Spencer Museum of Art, and KU Natural History Museum. Participate in our scavenger hunt to win a prize donated by the Spencer Museum of Art. Light food and non-alcoholic drinks will be provided at all venues. MCN attendees will be provided with a drink ticket to be used for a glass of beer or wine at the Jayhawk Welcome Center only. A cash bar will also be available at the Jayhawk Welcome Center.No separate registration or ticket is required.
Location: Jayhawk Welcome Center, Spencer Museum of Art, KU Natural History Museum
